messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — I opened PR #3456 to add embedding examples + a short guidance section on cache key design and a small quantization profile table. Need a quick copy + tech review before I merge.
Priya: Thanks — will do a pass today. Can you paste the SDK snippet you want in the examples? There was a streaming vs non-streaming confusion last time.
Alex: Pasted below (also in the PR):
```python
# python sdk example (non-streaming)
resp = client.embeddings.create(model='redwood-embed-1', input=['doc1', 'doc2'])
# cache key: model + first_128_chars_of_input + user_bucket
```
Priya: Nice, simple. Suggest adding a short note: "Avoid including volatile metadata (timestamps, session ids) in cache keys." I'll add that.
Jorge: Quick ML note — for 4-bit quant profiles we observed a small drop for embedding cosine similarity on short texts. Recommend profile: `q4_0` for batch <= 4 and `q8_0` for higher-precision workloads. I'll include the numbers (P@10 delta) as a footnote.
Sam: Small SDK nit: the code block uses `embeddings.create` but our JS SDK uses `client.embeddings.generate` in v1.5.0. Need to include both variants or indicate language.
Alex: Good catch. I'll add separate python/js blocks and mark the JS snippet as v1.5+ compatibility.
DocsBot: lint-check — PR #3456: missing anchor link for "cache key" (docs/lint/anchors). Please add anchor id.
Priya: I'll add the anchor and also a tiny example showing prefix/KV cache behavior when using repeated prompts. Will keep it < 4 lines.
Jorge: Also add a short sentence under "Recommendations" about when to prefer KV caching vs prefix caching for chat-like workloads. e.g., KV cache for long-running sessions, prefix cache for repeated initial instructions.
Sam: For the JS snippet I can drop a one-liner that shows `const embed = await client.embeddings.generate({model: 'redwood-embed-1', input})` and a comment about streaming not applied to embeddings.
Alex: Plan: Priya updates copy + anchors now, Sam adds JS snippet, Jorge drops the quant footnote, I will address DocsBot lint then merge after approvals. Target to ship in tomorrow's docs deploy. @Priya @Sam @Jorge any blockers?
Priya: None from my side, will PR the edits in ~1h. :rocket:
Jorge: No blockers, will upload the evaluation table to the PR as a CSV attachment.
Sam: Will open a tiny JS follow-up PR if we need to tweak for backward compat.
Alex: Awesome — thanks team. I'll mark this as ready-for-review when edits are in.
